title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.47
summary: Prefer mainstream, but automatically downgrade and keep the working weaker profile instead of retrying a failing high profile forever.
changes: Continue from high to balanced and low profiles when the preferred mainstream cannot produce a usable stream
Pin the first successful downgraded profile for later reconnects in the same backend session
Scope source failure memory by ONVIF profile so a failed mainstream does not poison the substream
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.47
description: Sticky profile downgrade for reliable Live View startup.
releaseNotes: A failed mainstream now yields to a weaker profile and the working fallback stays preferred for reconnects.
